name: Google Docs
tagline: Read your documents, and write and edit them.
summary: Read and edit the user's Google Docs, given a link. Adds to a document freely; rewrites or deletes what is already there only after the user approves.
can: Read a document you give it a link to
Add to a document, such as a new section or a summary
Rewrite or delete what is already there, only after you approve it
